purpose: Victim-centered, source-traceable documentary inquiry into documented crime and justice processes.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Protect victims and uncharged people; distinguish allegations from findings and avoid actionable crime details.
